name: Oatmeal Cookies II
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Put the oil, sugar, water, and vanilla together in a bowl. Mix well.
Add the oats, flour, salt, and baking soda.
Place on a greased baking sheet in lumps about 1 inch across and about 3 inches apart.
Bake at 191°C (375°F) for 10–12 minutes, and serve when the cookies have begun to brown.

culture.text: This recipe originates with the New York chapter of Food Not Bombs. These delicious cookies are very simple to make, and they require no unusual ingredients.
